newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo gains on mark, lifted by dollar, sterling.
newsitem.headline: Escudo gains on mark, lifted by dollar, sterling.

text.p: The escudo was gaining on the mark in early trade, lifted by the strength of the dollar and the British pound, traders said.
The currency was trading at 100.87/90 to the mark against its 100.94/97 close on Tuesday. Traders said it could push higher against the Germany currency if the dollar continued to strengthen.
"With the dollar and pound at these levels, the escudo should be even stronger against the mark and it could happen. We could see it back at 100.50," said one trader.
